text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Yorkdale Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting City Council to approve the designation of two northbound lanes at the intersection of Yorkdale Road and the William R. Allen Road Highway 401 North Ramp for right-turning vehicles only. This will increase vehicle capacity at the intersection. The designation is part of the redevelopment of Yorkdale Shopping Centre. There are no costs to the city to undertake this work.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the designation of the easterly northbound lane on William R. Allen Road and Yorkdale Road, between Yorkdale Road and a point 30.5 metres south, for right-turning and left-turning vehicles only. 2. City Council designate the two easterly northbound lanes on Yorkdale Road, between William R. Allen Road/Highway 401 north ramp and a point 58 metres south, for right-turning vehicles only. 3. City Council designate the westerly northbound lane on Yorkdale Road, between William R. Allen Road/Highway 401 north ramp and a point 58 metres south, for left-turning vehicles only.
